svg.aria-label: Fig 6. Planned review console and audit. Two queue trays (AI-flagged and random QA) feed a timeline screen for synthetic claim SYN-C-000042, and every action goes to an append-only audit trail of hash-linked blocks. An approvals panel has approve, edit and reject buttons, and a blue dotted track takes a reviewer edit to the feedback station.
svg.title: Fig 6. Planned review console and audit. Two queue trays (AI-flagged and random QA) feed a timeline screen for synthetic claim SYN-C-000042, and every action goes to an append-only audit trail of hash-linked blocks. An approvals panel has approve, edit and reject buttons, and a blue dotted track takes a reviewer edit to the feedback station.
svg.text: Synthetic claims only. Planned design, not built.
every AI action writes an audit_event
1 Two queues: claims the AI flags (wide set, guardrail hit, high dollar) and a random QA
sample of claims that the AI handled alone. The random sample measures true quality.
2 The claim timeline shows each AI and human action, the model, the prompt version and the sources.
3 The audit trail is append-only. Each row stores the hash of the row before it.
4 External or money actions (send an appeal, place a call) wait for a human click.
Write-offs and refunds need two people.
5 A reviewer edit, with a reason, becomes an eval case. The gate is then recalibrated.
black: 1 to 2 (a claim opens). 2 to 3 (each action is logged). 2 to 4 (an action waits for approval).
blue dotted: 4 to 5 (a reviewer edit becomes feedback). Short links join the audit blocks.
HUMAN CLICK FOR SEND OR CALL
